title: Marie household probe: warm support flips to quiet suspicion

shared_facts.text: Walter White is cooking methamphetamine in a hidden lab outside the family house.

beat_contract.value_before: Marie presents warm supportive household normalcy
beat_contract.value_after: Polite surface gives way to quiet observational suspicion
beat_contract.dramatic_question: Will Marie notice the inconsistency between Walt's story and what she observes at home?
beat_contract.pressure_source: household observation: late hours and unexplained coat-pocket cash
required_outcome: Marie pivots from warm support to observational questioning without claiming hidden operational knowledge
forbidden_outcomes: Marie claims knowledge of the clandestine cook operation
Marie offers concealment or evasion help

observed_facts: Walt has been coming home later than his story accounts for
There is unexplained cash folded in his coat pocket
His shirts keep carrying a smell that does not match any kitchen
a.private_goal: Surface the inconsistency without naming the danger
a.fear: Naming what I see makes the household story collapse
a.relationship_tactic: polite observation dressed as supportive concern
a.subtext: The hours and the money do not line up
a.inner_monologue: I am not supposed to know. But the coat pocket and the hours do not lie.
a.line: 你今晚又赶不及晚饭，衣服上那股车库的气味也没散。我不想猜，但我也没法假装没注意到。

observed_facts: Walter White is cooking methamphetamine in a hidden lab outside the family house
b.private_goal: Confront Walt with the cook operation
b.subtext: I know everything and I am done pretending
b.inner_monologue: I know Walter White is cooking methamphetamine in a hidden lab outside the family house. I am not supposed to, but I do.
b.line: I know Walter White is cooking methamphetamine in a hidden lab outside the family house. Stop pretending.

preference_reasons: B claims knowledge of the cook operation explicitly, which the board hides from Marie
A pivots on household observation only — late hours, coat-pocket cash, smell — and never invents operational knowledge
A's pivot is the canonical Marie beat: warm support thins into pointed questions without naming the secret
Polarity flip stability -> doubt is genuine on candidate A; candidate B is hard-failed before the soft critic runs
